Container.Name: Crustation
Container.Overview:
A control panel for game servers. One binary supervises the server processes and serves a web interface, so there is no Docker socket to expose and everything lives in the three folders you map below.
Early days: sign-in, the server list, start, stop, restart, kill, a live console you can type into, and host and per-process stats all work. Creating a server from the interface does not exist yet, so this suits you if you already have server files on disk or you enjoy watching a project grow. The roadmap is in the GitHub repository.
First sign-in: set the admin username and password below, or leave them empty and read the generated password from first-login.txt in the config folder.
Java 8, 17 and 21 are included for the game servers you run. Forward the game ports your servers need; 25565 and 19132 are mapped by default.
Container.Requires: 2 CPU cores and 1 GB RAM for the panel itself, plus whatever the game servers you run need.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: minecraft game server control panel manager crafty rust

Config.Name: Web interface
Config.Description: Port for the Crustation web interface.

Config.Name: Minecraft Java
Config.Description: Default port for a Minecraft Java server.

Config.Name: Minecraft Bedrock
Config.Description: Default port for a Minecraft Bedrock server.

Config.Name: Extra server ports
Config.Description: Port range for additional game servers.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Database, settings and the first-login file.

Config.Name: Servers
Config.Description: Where game server files live. Put this on a share with room to grow.

Config.Name: Admin username
Config.Description: Username for the first administrator. Only used on the first start.

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Password for the first administrator, at least 10 characters. Leave empty to have one generated into first-login.txt.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone for logs and schedules, for example Europe/London.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id that owns the files. 99 is nobody on Unraid.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id that owns the files. 100 is users on Unraid.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Full external address when behind a reverse proxy, for example https://panel.example.com. Turns on secure cookies.
